scope: Current triangle mesh, setup pose_2, every process magnitude from zero to K

units.mg: object weight; multiply both wrench blocks by weight in N for SI

parameters.phi_endpoint: periodic; 0 and 2*pi denote the same direction
parameters.boundary_normals: Face-wise normals; the set is the union of face families
parameters.q_m: a + u*(b-a) + v*(c-a); a,b,c are the indexed world triangle

mapping.set: { need(q,magnitude_mg*d) : every work face, every u,v,theta,phi in domain, 0 <= magnitude_mg <= K, reachable(q,d) }
mapping.pairing: Both blocks share exactly the same q and complete F_push

reachability.predicate: no object-mesh intersection along the outward half-ray
reachability.force_application_point: q itself, NEVER the offset ray origin
reachability.scope: Object self-occlusion only; the inherited tool-ray convention

sampling_measure.domain: reachable surface positions x allowed force directions x force-magnitude interval
sampling_measure.note: Defines the physical sampling distribution; samples.json contains the finite scoring input. No coverage is computed here.

provenance.force_cone_override: The setup snapshot fixes pose and work faces. Step 1 applies the current declared process cone.
